cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

mechanism: A copies a breathing behavior wrongly and converts correction into practical steps that keep B until A can face an empty home.
confusable: D98 requires eventual independence, not indefinite closeness.
comparison: Pre-operation speech practice versus empty kitchen routine.
seedUse: Keep B waiting for kettle as concrete support and A one-cup endpoint.
